tools.description: Create a draft: work-in-progress content that is saved but never publishes. Requires platform or a non-empty platforms array; draft_planned_for is a planning date only and schedules nothing. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

tools.name: aidelly_create_idea
tools.description: Create a new idea on the workspace's idea board, optionally seeded with an initial body or topic.

tools.description: Upload a photo to a connected platform's media gallery (separate from posts). Today only google_business is wired.

tools.description: Accept a post for immediate asynchronous publishing or future scheduling on a connected account. tools.name: aidelly_create_report

tools.description: Create a shareable link to a workspace report, either a fixed snapshot or a live view refreshed on a cadence. aidelly_revoke_report_link disables it. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

tools.name: aidelly_create_report_schedule
tools.description: Create a new report schedule. Soft-capped at 10 active schedules per workspace.

tools.name: aidelly_create_repurpose_job
tools.description: Run a synchronous repurpose job: extract source content, distill, and generate output for one (medium, shape) target.

tools.description: Create a manual short link on the workspace.

tools.name: aidelly_create_task

tools.name: aidelly_create_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook subscription for post lifecycle and inbox events (including inbox.lead.captured from the AI DM agent).

tools.name: aidelly_create_workspace
tools.description: Create a new workspace owned by the API key owner. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

tools.name: aidelly_delete_brain_document
tools.description: Permanently delete a workspace Brain document, its stored file and the Brain knowledge derived from it. This cannot be undone. Requires workspace settings permission. Retry-safe with the same idempotency_key.

tools.name: aidelly_delete_calendar_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event by id from the selected workspace. Removes the stored event, or cancels the post when the calendar uses scheduled posts as its backing store. Returns the deletion result. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

tools.name: aidelly_delete_content_automation
tools.description: Delete a content automation rule by id. Removes the saved rule so it no longer runs on future triggers; returns the deletion result. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

tools.name: aidelly_delete_draft

tools.name: aidelly_delete_task

tools.name: aidelly_delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook subscription by ID.

tools.name: aidelly_delete_workspace
tools.description: Soft-delete a workspace. confirm_name has to match the workspace name exactly. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

tools.name: aidelly_generate_inbox_reply_draft

tools.name: aidelly_list_repurpose_jobs

evidence.snippet: before: "PATCH /workspaces/{workspaceId} — update workspace name, archive state, kind, or mode." → after: "Update a workspace's name, archive state, kind, or mode. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "aidelly_update_workspace_member" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "PATCH /workspaces/{workspaceId}/members — update a workspace member role." → after: "Change a workspace member's role, which changes what they can access. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
